content.body:
Add an `unclaim <folder>` verb to vwf's plan-management skill: reset a stale RUNNING row in docs/plans/index.md back to APPROVED so the plan can be claimed afresh by /vwf:execute.

Today the only release of a RUNNING claim is a hand edit of the row, committed on the integration branch (plan-management's 'What this skill never does' — 'Take a RUNNING row'). A session that died mid-run leaves the row RUNNING forever; the verb makes the reset a named, consent-gated operation with the same commit shape as claim/complete (docs: plan queue — <folder> unclaimed), refusing when the worktree named in the folder's Status block still exists.

Origin: docs/backlog.md B12 (P1 there; P0 here), carried over when the backlog moved to this project on 2026-09-18.
